context.setting: A dealership showroom. Meera has a written quotation for her selected vehicle version. It lists optional additions separately; their amounts still need confirmation.
context.learnerRole: Car Sales Executive responsible for explaining the quotation; price changes require the Sales Manager's confirmation.
context.objective: Explain which quoted figure applies to the selected version and separate it from additions and an unconfirmed final total.
constraints: Refer to the written quotation without inventing numerical prices or charges.
Do not promise a price change, approval, finance terms or a final total awaiting confirmation.
Give no financial or regulatory advice.

turns.speaker: You

turns.speaker: Meera
turns.text: So I cannot use this figure as the total with additions?

turns.speaker: You

content.title: Arranging and conducting a test drive — Car Sales Executive (B1)

context.setting: A dealership showroom. Kunal is comparing two versions of a model. The comparison sheet shows more boot space in the larger version. He wants a test-drive appointment; availability has not been checked.
context.learnerRole: Car Sales Executive coordinating the customer's appointment request.
context.objective: Compare the stated space feature, ask permission to send an appointment request, and clarify the requested time, proposed meeting point and next contact.
constraints: No driving, road-safety, vehicle-operation or safety-training instructions; no regulatory or safety advice.
Refer to the dealership's test-drive policy generically; do not invent policy requirements.
Do not promise vehicle availability or an appointment before confirmation.

turns.speaker: Kunal
turns.text: Which version has more space for our luggage?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: The comparison sheet shows more boot space in the larger version.

turns.speaker: Kunal
turns.text: I'd like to arrange a test drive for that version.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: May I send an appointment request for the larger version?

turns.speaker: Kunal
turns.text: Yes, please. Friday at three would suit me.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: May I include Friday at three as your preferred time?

turns.speaker: Kunal
turns.text: Yes. Where would we meet?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: May I suggest showroom reception as the meeting point, subject to appointment confirmation?

turns.speaker: Kunal
turns.text: That works. Please email me when you know.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: May I email you the confirmed details after checking availability under the dealership's test-drive policy?

turns.speaker: Kunal
turns.text: Yes. I'll wait for that email before making plans.

content.title: Following up after a quotation or visit — Car Sales Executive (B1)

context.setting: A telephone follow-up after Aditi's showroom visit. She received a quotation for her chosen version and agreed to a follow-up call. Her purchase decision remains open.
context.learnerRole: Car Sales Executive following up respectfully on an earlier enquiry.
context.objective: Refer to the earlier quotation, check whether the customer can talk, invite questions and agree the next contact without pressure.
constraints: Do not assume the customer has decided to buy.
Do not invent prices, stock availability, delivery dates, finance terms or approvals.
Respect the customer's stated contact preference; give no financial or regulatory advice.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Hello, Aditi. I'm following up on the quotation after your showroom visit. Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: Aditi
turns.text: I have a few minutes, but I haven't decided yet.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Have you had a chance to look at the quotation for your chosen version?

turns.speaker: Aditi
turns.text: Yes. I still have a question about the optional additions.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Which part would you like us to clarify before you consider the quotation further?

turns.speaker: Aditi
turns.text: I'd like to know which additions are included. Please reply by email.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I'll check that question. When would you prefer us to follow up again?

turns.speaker: Aditi
turns.text: Please wait until I've read the email. I'll contact you if I need anything else.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Understood. I'll send the clarification after checking it and leave the next contact to you.

turns.speaker: Aditi
turns.text: Thank you. That would help.
